item.af9.fx_fuel_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Sintered uranium oxide: natural uranium with U-235 to start the chain reaction.
item.af9.fx_fuel_rod.tooltip.0: §7Pellets in a zirconium cladding: one cycle of the FX-1 Reactor.
item.af9.fx_spent_fuel_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor: plutonium bred, uranium left, fission products in it.
item.af9.fx_spent_fuel_rod.tooltip.1: §cStrongly radioactive.§7 Reprocess it: macerate, dissolve, centrifuge.
item.af9.fx_mox_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Plutonium and uranium mixed oxide: hotter and longer-lived than uranium.
item.af9.fx_mox_rod.tooltip.0: §7MOX pellets in a zirconium cladding: the plutonium loop closed.
item.af9.fx_spent_mox_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor: plutonium and minor actinides bred.
item.af9.fx_spent_mox_rod.tooltip.1: §cStrongly radioactive.§7 Reprocess it: more plutonium comes back than went in.
item.af9.fx_mox_2_pellet.tooltip.0: §7More plutonium per pellet: hotter than MOX.
item.af9.fx_mox_2_rod.tooltip.0: §7MOX-2 pellets in zirconium. Burns in the Mk1.
item.af9.fx_spent_mox_2_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor: plutonium and minor actinides.
item.af9.fx_mox_3_rod.tooltip.0: §7MOX-3 pellets in zirconium. Burns in the Mk2 only.
item.af9.fx_spent_mox_3_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the Mk2: plutonium and minor actinides.
item.af9.fx_mox_4_rod.tooltip.0: §7MOX-4 pellets in zirconium. Burns in the Mk2 only.
item.af9.fx_spent_mox_4_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the Mk2: the richest reprocessing feed.
item.af9.fx_thorium_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Thorium oxide with a U-235 driver: long life at half the steam rate.
item.af9.fx_thorium_rod.tooltip.0: §7Thorium pellets in a zirconium cladding: the patient fuel.
item.af9.fx_spent_thorium_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor: thorium left, protactinium bred.
item.af9.fx_heu_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Highly-enriched uranium oxide: twice the steam rate of LEU, enrichment-hungry.
item.af9.fx_heu_rod.tooltip.0: §7HEU pellets in a zirconium cladding: the hot uranium cycle.
item.af9.fx_spent_heu_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor: uranium left, plutonium bred.
item.af9.fx_spent_heu_rod.tooltip.1: §cStrongly radioactive.§7 Reprocess it in the uranium stream.
item.af9.fx_lep_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Low-enriched plutonium oxide: LEU energy at twice the rate.
item.af9.fx_lep_rod.tooltip.0: §7LEP pellets in a zirconium cladding: the fast plutonium cycle.
item.af9.fx_spent_lep_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor: plutonium and minor actinides.
item.af9.fx_spent_lep_rod.tooltip.1: §cStrongly radioactive.§7 Reprocess it in the MOX stream.
item.af9.fx_hep_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Highly-enriched plutonium oxide: the fastest fuel, four times LEU rate.
item.af9.fx_hep_rod.tooltip.0: §7HEP pellets in a zirconium cladding: bring turbine hall capacity.
item.af9.fx_spent_hep_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor: the richest Mk1 reprocessing feed.
item.af9.fx_spent_hep_rod.tooltip.1: §cStrongly radioactive.§7 Reprocess it in the MOX stream.
item.af9.fx_blanket_assembly.tooltip.0: §7Depleted uranium around a running core breeds plutonium-239.
item.af9.fx_spent_blanket.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor: bred plutonium in it.
item.af9.fx_np_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Neptunium oxide in a uranium matrix: burns the minor actinide for heat. Molten-salt cycles of the FX Reactor Mk2 only.
item.af9.fx_np_rod.tooltip.0: §7Four neptunium pellets in a zirconium cladding.
item.af9.fx_spent_np_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor. Americium and plutonium are left in the spent rod.
item.af9.fx_am_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Americium oxide in a thorium matrix: a fast-spectrum burner. Molten-salt cycles of the FX Reactor Mk2 only.
item.af9.fx_am_rod.tooltip.0: §7Four americium pellets in a zirconium cladding.
item.af9.fx_spent_am_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor. Curium is bred in the spent rod.
item.af9.fx_cm_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Curium oxide in a plutonium matrix: the hottest burner short of californium. Molten-salt cycles of the FX Reactor Mk2 only.
item.af9.fx_cm_rod.tooltip.0: §7Four curium pellets in a zirconium cladding.
item.af9.fx_spent_cm_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor. Californium is bred in the spent rod.
item.af9.fx_cf_pellet.tooltip.0: §7Californium oxide in a plutonium matrix: the end of the actinide ladder. Molten-salt cycles of the FX Reactor Mk2 only.
item.af9.fx_cf_rod.tooltip.0: §7Four californium pellets in a zirconium cladding.
item.af9.fx_spent_cf_rod.tooltip.0: §7Out of the reactor. Almost all of it is burned.
item.af9.graphite_green_body.tooltip.0: §7Graphite and coal tar pressed together, still soft: bake it.
item.af9.graphite_baked_body.tooltip.0: §7The binder is coked out. Graphitise it in argon, then purify it.
item.af9.graphite_billet.tooltip.0: §7Chlorine took the boron out: reactor grade, a neutron poison no more.
item.af9.graphite_moderator.tooltip.0: §7Slows the neutrons of the thermal fuels: needed, and not used up, by the uranium, plutonium and thorium molten-salt cycles of the FX Reactor Mk2.
item.af9.graphite_moderator.tooltip.1: §7The fast burners (neptunium to californium) run without it.

item.af9.qram_chip.tooltip.0: Quantum Aligned Random Access Memory on strange matter

item.af9.qlos_chip.tooltip.0: Quantum-dot CPU: control logic in single-electron transistors

item.af9.euv_mask_blank.tooltip.0: Reflective photomask blank for the 50 nm and finer chips (TPU, TMD Logic, Memristor, Quantum-Dot IC, QRAM, QLOS).
item.af9.edram_cpu_package.tooltip.0: A CPU die with its eDRAM cache on one package.
item.af9.edram_soc_package.tooltip.0: An SoC with its eDRAM cache on one package.
item.af9.asic_package.tooltip.0: An ASIC die with its RAM on a silicon interposer. HV-EV bridge of the linear ladder.
item.af9.photonic_package.tooltip.0: A photonic IC with its spin-logic memory on one package. XPS bridge of the linear ladder.
A gold-contact backplane connector that ties the computer boards of a mainframe together.
item.af9.xps_processor.tooltip.0: Extreme-photonic processor: UHV wetware mainframe recombined with photonics.
item.af9.xps_processor_mainframe.tooltip: Photonic mainframe of the XPS tier. Needs plasma soldering.
item.af9.nvm_processor.tooltip.0: Non-volatile-memory processor: XPS mainframe with memristive memory.
item.af9.nvm_processor_mainframe.tooltip: Top of the linear ladder. Memory that computes.
item.af9.pico_board.tooltip.0: Ceranium board of the Pico line, laid up at UV. Orbital Array Mk2 only.
item.af9.cleansed_pico_board.tooltip.0: A pico board stripped of every stray particle.
item.af9.pico_cpu.tooltip.0: The Pico line's core: TPU, memristor and quantum-dot dies on a cleansed board. Goes into the XPS processor.
A Pico CPU with its photonic and spin-logic dies in order. Goes into the XPS mainframe.
item.af9.processed_pico_circuit_casing.t: Chromodynium-plated housing for a Pico rack.
item.af9.pico_circuit_rack.tooltip.0: Four organized Pico circuits in one casing. Goes into the NVM processor.
item.af9.xps_board.tooltip.0: Placeholder board of sand-and-dirt alloy, traced in sanguinite. Laid up in the HILE.
item.af9.silicon_carbide_substrate.toolt: A silicon carbide plate fired onto molybdenum foil. Cut into Ceramic Circuit Boards in the chemical reactor (MV).
item.af9.alumina_substrate.tooltip.0: A alumina plate fired onto cupronickel foil. Cut into Ceramic Circuit Boards in the chemical reactor (HV).
item.af9.beryllia_substrate.tooltip.0: A beryllia plate fired onto chromium. Cut into Ceramic Circuit Boards in the chemical reactor (EV).
item.af9.ai_acceleration_card.tooltip.0: TPU and memristor on a wetware board, traced in sanguinite. Compute card of the new DTPF.
item.af9.interconnect.tooltip.0: One straight gold/electrum Leiterbahn. Traces of everything from Pico to NVM.
item.af9.interconnect_pallet.tooltip.0: A pallet of interconnect strips, ready to lay.
item.af9.rocket_cone_tier_2.tooltip.0: §7The nose of a tier 2 rocket: a heat cap on a hull of rocket alloy, ringed with insulation tile.
item.af9.rocket_fin_tier_2.tooltip.0: §7A swept fin of a tier 2 rocket. Four of them steer it.
item.af9.alumina_silicate_rocket_insulat: §7A panel of ceramic tiles. It keeps the tier 2 rocket's hull from burning through on re-entry.
item.af9.alumina_silicate_insulation_foi: §7A thin ceramic sheet, the lining of the insulation panels.
item.af9.insulation_wool.tooltip.0: §7Ceramic fibre spun to a fine wire. Wound into the insulation panels.
item.af9.optical_ram.tooltip.0: Optically compatible RAM for the Chromodynium circuits at NVM.
item.af9.optical_cpu.tooltip.0: Optically compatible CPU for the Chromodynium circuits at NVM.
item.af9.fiber_interconnects.tooltip.0: Optical junctions between fiber and die. Laid up at UV; the traces of the Ceranium Pico board.
item.af9.optical_fiber_cable.tooltip.0: Thin glass fiber for circuits. Not GT's fat trunk fiber.
item.af9.beryllium_spallation_target.too: Proton beam in, neutrons out. Wears out after four wafers.
item.af9.magnetic_trap.tooltip.0: An empty superconducting trap for quark-gluon plasma.
item.af9.qgp_trap.tooltip.0: Quark-gluon plasma from a heavy-ion collision, held in a magnetic trap.
item.af9.molecular_sieve.tooltip.0: Dries air for extreme clean dry air. Comes out saturated.
item.af9.saturated_molecular_sieve.toolt: Smelt it to drive the water out and reuse it.
item.af9.ule_glass_substrate.tooltip.0: Quartz doped with titania: it hardly expands when it heats up. The ground-flat body of an EUV mirror.
item.af9.mo_si_mirror.tooltip.0: Forty bilayers of molybdenum and silicon: reflects 13.5 nm EUV light, which no lens can pass.
item.af9.mo_si_mirror.tooltip.1: The collector of the EUV Light Source and the projection optics of the Orbital Lithography Station.
item.af9.dry_resist_cartridge.tooltip.0: Vapour-deposition resist for the Orbital Lithography Station. One per wafer.
item.af9.glass_tube_mold.tooltip.0: §7Mold for Create's Spout: pour 144 mB of molten glass into it.
item.af9.glass_tube_mold.tooltip.1: §7Not consumed: the press gives it back with the tube.
§7Press it (Create press on a depot): a glass tube and the empty mold.
